text:
Chip Fields played Rochelle, one of J.J.'s girlfriends, in "J.J.'s New Career, Part 2" (Season 4, Episode 8, aired 1976), per [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chip_Fields) and [TVmaze](https://www.tvmaze.com/characters/204646/good-times-rochelle). I confirmed this with a fresh search, but I did not re-verify the later Lynnetta Gordon role from my earlier answer, so I'm not restating it. The Yidio listing describes the episode differently, but the Peacock and TVmaze descriptions are the more reliable ones.

CONFIDENCE: 90
